name: Dumbbell Deadlift
short_description: Hinge at the hips with a neutral spine to lower two dumbbells beside the feet, then stand up to full hip extension.

name: Dumbbell Suitcase Deadlift
short_description: Deadlift one dumbbell held at one side, resisting lean so the torso stays square.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
short_description: From standing, push the hips back with soft knees, sliding the dumbbells down the thighs to mid-shin, then drive the hips forward.

name: Dumbbell Staggered-Stance RDL
short_description: Perform an RDL with most weight on the front leg and the back toe resting lightly behind for balance.

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
short_description: Balance on one leg and hinge forward, reaching the dumbbell toward the floor while the free leg extends behind, then return tall.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
short_description: With a wide stance and toes out, hold one dumbbell vertically between the legs and stand up by driving the knees out and hips through.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift High Pull
short_description: From a sumo deadlift, extend the hips explosively and pull the dumbbell to chin height with elbows high and outside.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Good Morning
short_description: Hold a dumbbell at the chest and hinge at the hips with soft knees until the torso nears parallel, then return.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Swing
short_description: Hike the dumbbell between the legs and snap the hips to float it to eye level or overhead with a straight arm.

name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
short_description: Lie on your back with a dumbbell across the hips, feet planted, and drive the hips up until knees, hips, and shoulders align.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
short_description: With upper back on a bench and a dumbbell on the hips, drive the hips up to full extension and squeeze the glutes.

name: Dumbbell Hang Power Clean
short_description: From the hang at mid-thigh, jump and shrug to pull the dumbbells up and receive them on the shoulders in a partial squat.

name: Dumbbell Power Clean
short_description: Lift the dumbbells from the floor, extend the hips explosively, and receive them on the shoulders in a partial squat.

name: Dumbbell Squat Clean
short_description: Clean the dumbbells from the floor and receive them on the shoulders in a full front squat before standing.

name: Dumbbell Hang Squat Clean
short_description: From the hang, pull the dumbbells to the shoulders and ride the receive into a full squat.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Hang Power Clean
short_description: Hold one dumbbell at the hang, jump and shrug, and receive it on the same shoulder in a partial squat.

name: Dumbbell Hang Clean-to-Overhead
short_description: Clean one dumbbell from the hang to the shoulder and get it overhead by any method (press, push press, or jerk).

name: Dumbbell Clean and Jerk
short_description: Clean two dumbbells from the floor to the shoulders, then dip and drive to jerk them to locked-out arms overhead.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Clean and Jerk
short_description: Clean one dumbbell from the floor to the shoulder, then jerk it overhead to a locked-out arm.

name: Dumbbell Hang Clean and Press
short_description: Hang power clean two dumbbells to the shoulders, then strict press them overhead without leg drive.

name: Dumbbell Power Snatch
short_description: Pull one dumbbell from the floor with an explosive hip extension and punch it overhead in one motion, receiving in a partial squat.

name: Dumbbell Hang Power Snatch
short_description: From the hang at mid-thigh, jump and pull one dumbbell straight overhead, receiving in a partial squat.

name: Dumbbell Squat Snatch
short_description: Snatch one dumbbell from the floor and receive it locked out overhead in a full overhead squat.

name: Dumbbell Muscle Snatch
short_description: Extend the hips and pull the dumbbell up the body with a high elbow, then turn it over to lockout without rebending the knees.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Snatch
short_description: Perform dumbbell power snatches, switching hands at the bottom or top of every rep.

name: Double Dumbbell Snatch
short_description: Swing or pull two dumbbells from the floor and extend explosively to punch both overhead in one motion.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell High Pull
short_description: From the hang, extend the hips explosively and pull one dumbbell to shoulder height with the elbow high and outside.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
short_description: Front squat with dumbbells on the shoulders and use the drive out of the bottom to press them overhead in one fluid motion.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Thruster
short_description: Hold one dumbbell at the shoulder, squat, and drive up to press it overhead in one motion.

name: Dumbbell Cluster
short_description: Squat clean two dumbbells from the floor and immediately drive out of the squat into a thruster.

name: Dumbbell Front Squat
short_description: With dumbbells resting on the shoulders and elbows up, squat below parallel and stand to full hip extension.

name: Goblet Squat
short_description: Hold one dumbbell vertically at the chest and squat between the knees with the torso upright.

name: Dumbbell Hang Squat
short_description: Hold dumbbells at the sides with straight arms and squat to depth, keeping the chest tall.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
short_description: Take a wide, toes-out stance and squat with one dumbbell hanging between the legs, driving the knees out.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Squat
short_description: Lock one dumbbell overhead with an active shoulder and squat to full depth while keeping it stacked over the mid-foot.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
short_description: Hold dumbbells at the sides and rise onto the balls of the feet as high as possible, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Cossack Squat
short_description: From a wide stance with a goblet-held dumbbell, sit deep into one hip while the opposite leg straightens with toes up.

name: Dumbbell Front-Rack Lunge
short_description: With dumbbells on the shoulders, step forward and lower the back knee to touch the ground, then stand to full extension.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
short_description: Hold dumbbells at the sides and walk forward in alternating lunges, touching the back knee down each step.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Walking Lunge
short_description: Lock one dumbbell overhead and perform walking lunges while keeping the arm vertical and the torso upright.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
short_description: Step one foot back and lower the back knee toward the floor while holding dumbbells, then drive through the front heel to return.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge to Press
short_description: Perform a reverse lunge with dumbbells at the shoulders and press them overhead as you return to standing.

name: Dumbbell Split Squat
short_description: From a fixed split stance holding dumbbells, lower straight down until the back knee nearly touches, then stand.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
short_description: With the rear foot on a bench or couch, lower into a split squat holding dumbbells, keeping the front knee tracking over the toes.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
short_description: Holding a dumbbell at the chest, step wide to one side and sit the hips back over that foot, keeping the other leg straight.

name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge
short_description: Step one leg diagonally behind the other and lower into a lunge while holding dumbbells, then return.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
short_description: Holding dumbbells, step onto a box or sturdy bench with one foot and stand fully on top before stepping down.

name: Dumbbell Box Step-Over
short_description: Carry dumbbells up onto a box and step down the other side, alternating direction each rep.

name: Dumbbell Strict Press
short_description: From the shoulders, press both dumbbells straight overhead to lockout without using the legs.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Strict Press
short_description: Press one dumbbell from the shoulder to lockout overhead while bracing to keep the torso from leaning.

name: Dumbbell Push Press
short_description: Dip slightly at the knees and drive through the legs to propel the dumbbells overhead, finishing with a press to lockout.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Push Press
short_description: Dip and drive with the legs to push one dumbbell from the shoulder to lockout overhead.

name: Dumbbell Push Jerk
short_description: Dip and drive the dumbbells upward, then re-bend the knees to catch them locked out overhead before standing.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Split Jerk
short_description: Dip and drive one dumbbell overhead while splitting the feet front and back to receive, then recover the feet together.

name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
short_description: Start with palms facing you at chin height and rotate the palms forward while pressing the dumbbells overhead.

name: Dumbbell Z Press
short_description: Sit on the floor with legs straight out and press dumbbells overhead without leaning back.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
short_description: Raise light dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height with slightly bent elbows, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
short_description: Raise dumbbells straight in front to shoulder height with nearly straight arms, then lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
short_description: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower it behind the head by bending the elbows, then extend.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
short_description: Lie on the floor with knees bent and press dumbbells from elbows-on-floor to lockout over the chest.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
short_description: Lie on a bench and press dumbbells from chest level to lockout over the shoulders, lowering under control.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
short_description: Press one dumbbell on a bench while bracing the core to keep from rotating off the bench.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
short_description: On an inclined bench, press dumbbells from upper chest to lockout above the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Floor Fly
short_description: Lying on the floor with arms slightly bent, open the dumbbells out wide until the upper arms touch the floor, then hug them back together.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
short_description: Lying on the floor or a bench, lower the dumbbells toward the temples by bending only the elbows, then extend.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
short_description: Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back and row both dumbbells to the lower ribs, then lower under control.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
short_description: Brace a hand on a knee or bench in a staggered hinge and row one dumbbell toward the hip.

name: Dumbbell Gorilla Row
short_description: From a wide, deep hinge with dumbbells on the floor, alternately row one dumbbell while the other stays planted.

name: Dumbbell Renegade Row
short_description: In a high plank on two dumbbells with feet wide, row one dumbbell to the hip while resisting rotation, then alternate.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
short_description: Hinge forward and raise light dumbbells out to the sides with slightly bent arms, squeezing the shoulder blades.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
short_description: With elbows pinned at the sides, curl the dumbbells up to the shoulders and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
short_description: Curl the dumbbells with palms facing each other, keeping the elbows still.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
short_description: Pull dumbbells up along the front of the body to chest height, leading with the elbows.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
short_description: Lying on the floor or a bench with one dumbbell held overhead in both hands, lower it behind the head with long arms, then pull it back over the chest.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
short_description: Hold heavy dumbbells at the sides and elevate the shoulders straight up toward the ears, pause, and lower.

name: Dumbbell Farmers Carry
short_description: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and walk tall with braced core and short, quick steps.

name: Dumbbell Suitcase Carry
short_description: Carry one dumbbell at one side and walk without leaning or letting the torso shift.

name: Dumbbell Front-Rack Carry
short_description: Hold dumbbells on the shoulders with elbows up and walk while keeping the ribcage down.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Carry
short_description: Lock one dumbbell overhead with a stacked, active shoulder and walk without letting the arm drift forward.

name: Double Dumbbell Overhead Carry
short_description: Lock out two dumbbells overhead and walk with ribs down and biceps by the ears.

name: Dumbbell Turkish Get-Up
short_description: From lying with one dumbbell locked out overhead, move step by step to standing and back down while keeping the arm vertical.

name: Dumbbell Half Turkish Get-Up
short_description: From lying with a dumbbell locked out overhead, roll to the elbow, then the hand, then bridge the hips before reversing.

name: Dumbbell Windmill
short_description: With one dumbbell locked out overhead and feet angled, hinge sideways to reach the free hand toward the floor while eyes stay on the dumbbell.

name: Dumbbell Man Maker
short_description: On two dumbbells perform a push-up and a row on each side, jump the feet in, clean the dumbbells, and thruster them overhead.

name: Devil Press
short_description: Perform a burpee with hands on two dumbbells, then hinge and swing both dumbbells from the floor to overhead in one motion.

name: Dumbbell Burpee Deadlift
short_description: With hands on two dumbbells, jump the feet back to a push-up and in again, then deadlift the dumbbells to standing.

name: Burpee Over Dumbbell
short_description: Perform a burpee beside a dumbbell lying on its side, then jump laterally over it with both feet.

name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
short_description: Sit leaning back with heels light and rotate a dumbbell from hip to hip.

name: Dumbbell Woodchop
short_description: Hold one dumbbell with both hands and swing it diagonally from above one shoulder to outside the opposite knee, pivoting the feet.

name: Dumbbell Halo
short_description: Hold one dumbbell by the horns at the chest and circle it around the head close to the neck, alternating directions.

name: Dumbbell Sit-Up
short_description: Holding one dumbbell at the chest or locked out overhead, perform a full sit-up from lying to upright.

name: Dumbbell V-Up
short_description: Holding a light dumbbell in both hands overhead, lift the arms and legs together to meet over the hips.

name: Dumbbell Plank Pull-Through
short_description: In a high plank, reach under the body with one hand and drag a dumbbell to the opposite side without rocking the hips.

name: Air Squat
short_description: With feet shoulder-width, push the hips back and down until the hip crease is below the knees, then stand to full extension.

name: Squat to Target
short_description: Squat down until the hips lightly touch a chair, low box, or bench, then stand; used to scale depth.

name: Pause Air Squat
short_description: Perform an air squat and hold the bottom position for a set count before standing.

name: Cossack Squat
short_description: From a wide stance, shift deep into one bent leg while the other leg stays straight with toes pointing up.

name: Pistol Squat
short_description: Squat on one leg to full depth with the other leg held straight in front, then stand without touching down.

name: Shrimp Squat
short_description: Holding the back foot behind you, lower on one leg until the rear knee touches the ground, then stand.

name: Wall Sit
short_description: Lean back against a wall with knees bent about 90 degrees and hold the position.

name: Forward Lunge
short_description: Step forward and lower until the back knee touches the floor, then push back to the start.

name: Reverse Lunge
short_description: Step one foot back and lower the back knee to the floor, then drive through the front foot to stand.

name: Walking Lunge
short_description: Lunge forward continuously, touching the back knee down each step and standing to full hip extension.

name: Split Squat
short_description: In a fixed split stance, lower straight down until the back knee nearly touches and rise.

name: Bodyweight Bulgarian Split Squat
short_description: With the rear foot on a bench or couch, lower into a deep split squat and drive up through the front foot.

name: Lateral Lunge
short_description: Step wide to one side, sit back into that hip with the other leg straight, then push back to center.

name: Curtsy Lunge
short_description: Step one leg diagonally behind the other and lower into a lunge, then return.

name: Transverse Lunge
short_description: Pivot and step one foot back at a 135-degree angle into a lunge, then return to the start.

name: Step-Up
short_description: Step onto a stable box, bench, or stair with one foot and stand fully before stepping down.

name: Glute Bridge
short_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and drive the hips up until shoulders, hips, and knees align.

name: Glute Bridge March
short_description: Hold a glute bridge and alternately lift each foot a few inches off the floor without the hips dropping.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
short_description: Perform a glute bridge driving through one foot with the other leg extended.

name: Bodyweight Single-Leg RDL
short_description: Balance on one leg and hinge forward with a flat back while the free leg reaches behind, then return.

name: Superman
short_description: Lying face down, lift arms, chest, and legs off the floor together, pause, and lower.

name: Arch Rock
short_description: Hold a superman arch and rock forward and back from chest to thighs without losing the shape.

name: Calf Raise
short_description: Rise onto the balls of the feet as high as possible, pause, and lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
short_description: Balance on one foot, using a wall lightly for balance, and perform full-range calf raises.

name: Push-Up
short_description: From a rigid plank, lower the chest to the floor with elbows angled back, then press to lockout.

name: Bent-Knee Push-Up
short_description: Perform a push-up from the knees, keeping a straight line from knees to head.

name: Incline Push-Up
short_description: Place hands on a bench, box, or countertop and perform push-ups with a rigid body.

name: Decline Push-Up
short_description: With feet elevated on a bench or step, lower the chest to the floor and press up.

name: Hand-Release Push-Up
short_description: Lower all the way to the floor, lift the hands briefly, then replace them and press back to plank.

name: Diamond Push-Up
short_description: Place the hands together under the chest with thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond and perform push-ups.

name: Wide-Grip Push-Up
short_description: Perform push-ups with the hands set wider than shoulder-width.

name: Staggered-Hand Push-Up
short_description: Perform push-ups with one hand set forward and the other back, switching each set.

name: Archer Push-Up
short_description: From a very wide hand position, lower toward one hand while the other arm straightens out to the side.

name: Spiderman Push-Up
short_description: As you lower into a push-up, bring one knee to the same-side elbow, alternating each rep.

name: Hindu Push-Up
short_description: From a downward-dog position, swoop the chest low between the hands and up into a cobra, then push back.

name: Push-Up + Shoulder Taps
short_description: Perform a push-up, then tap each shoulder with the opposite hand while holding plank.

name: Pike Push-Up
short_description: With hips piked high, bend the elbows to lower the head toward the floor in front of the hands, then press up.

name: Handstand Push-Up (Wall)
short_description: Kick up to a handstand against a wall, lower the head to the floor, and press to lockout.

name: Kipping Handstand Push-Up
short_description: From head-down in a wall handstand, tuck the knees and kick the legs up while pressing to lockout.

name: Wall Walk
short_description: From a push-up position with feet at the wall, walk the feet up and hands in until chest touches the wall, then walk back down.

name: Wall-Facing Handstand Hold
short_description: Walk the feet up a wall until the body is nearly vertical with chest facing the wall, and hold with a hollow body.

name: Handstand Walk
short_description: Kick up to a freestanding handstand and walk forward on the hands while keeping balance.

name: Bench Dip
short_description: With hands on the edge of a bench or chair behind you, lower the hips by bending the elbows to about 90 degrees, then press up.

name: Front Plank
short_description: Hold a straight line from head to heels on forearms or hands with glutes and abs braced.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
short_description: In a high plank with feet wide, tap one shoulder with the opposite hand without rocking the hips.

name: Plank Up-Down
short_description: Move from a forearm plank to a high plank one arm at a time and back down, alternating the lead arm.

name: Side Plank
short_description: Support the body on one forearm and the side of the feet, keeping hips lifted in a straight line.

name: Modified Side Plank
short_description: Perform a side plank with the knees bent and supported on the floor.

name: Side Plank Hip Dip
short_description: From a side plank, lower the hip toward the floor and lift it back up for reps.

name: Hollow Hold
short_description: Lying on your back, press the low back into the floor and lift shoulders and straight legs, arms overhead, and hold.

name: Hollow Rock
short_description: Hold the hollow position and rock from upper back to tailbone without breaking the shape.

name: Dead Bug
short_description: On your back with arms up and knees over hips, slowly extend opposite arm and leg while keeping the low back flat.

name: Bird Dog
short_description: On hands and knees, extend the opposite arm and leg while keeping the hips level, then switch.

name: Sit-Up
short_description: From lying with arms overhead, sit up until the shoulders pass over the hips and touch the floor beyond the feet; an AbMat is optional.

name: Crunch
short_description: With knees bent, curl the shoulder blades off the floor toward the pelvis and lower slowly.

name: Reverse Crunch
short_description: Lying on your back, curl the knees toward the chest and lift the hips slightly off the floor, then lower.

name: Bicycle Crunch
short_description: Alternate touching elbow to opposite knee while extending the other leg in a pedaling motion.

name: V-Up
short_description: From lying fully extended, lift arms and straight legs simultaneously to meet over the hips.

name: Alternating V-Up
short_description: Lift one straight leg and both arms to touch the foot, alternating legs each rep.

name: Tuck-Up
short_description: From a hollow position, pull the knees and chest together into a tuck, then extend back out.

name: Lying Leg Raise
short_description: Lying on your back, raise straight legs to vertical and lower slowly without arching the low back.

name: Flutter Kicks
short_description: In a shallow hollow position, alternate small, quick up-and-down kicks with straight legs.

name: Heel Taps
short_description: With knees bent and shoulders lifted, crunch side to side to tap each heel with the same-side hand.

name: Russian Twist
short_description: Sit leaning back with feet light or lifted and rotate the hands from hip to hip.

name: Lying Windshield Wiper
short_description: Lying on your back with legs vertical and arms out, lower the legs to one side and then the other under control.

name: L-Sit (Floor)
short_description: Press the hands into the floor beside the hips and lift the hips and straight legs off the ground; scale with bent knees.

name: Mountain Climber
short_description: In a high plank, drive the knees toward the chest one at a time in a running rhythm.

name: Cross-Body Mountain Climber
short_description: Perform mountain climbers driving each knee toward the opposite elbow.

name: Bear Hold
short_description: From hands and knees, lift the knees an inch off the ground and hold with a flat back.

name: Bear Crawl
short_description: On hands and toes with knees hovering just off the ground, crawl forward moving opposite hand and foot together.

name: Lateral Bear Crawl
short_description: Move sideways in a bear position, stepping hands and feet laterally without letting the hips rise.

name: Crab Walk
short_description: Sitting with hands behind and hips lifted, walk forward or backward on hands and feet.

name: Inchworm
short_description: Hinge to place the hands on the floor, walk them out to a plank, then walk the feet up toward the hands.

name: Burpee
short_description: Drop the chest to the floor, push up, jump the feet to the hands, and stand with a small jump and clap overhead.

name: Up-Down
short_description: Step back into plank, lower the chest, then step the feet in and stand without jumping.

name: Squat Thrust
short_description: Squat to place hands on the floor, jump the feet back to plank, jump them back in, and stand.

name: Sprawl
short_description: Quickly drop the hips to the floor with legs back and chest low, then pop back up to an athletic stance.

name: Sit-Through
short_description: From a bear position, lift one hand and thread the opposite leg under the body to kick through, then return and switch.

name: Walk
short_description: Walk briskly with an upright posture for distance or time; the low-impact substitute for running.

name: Run
short_description: Run at a sustainable pace over a set distance or time.

name: Sprint
short_description: Run at maximal effort for a short distance with full recovery between efforts.

name: Shuttle Run
short_description: Run back and forth between two lines, touching the ground or line at each turn.

name: Lateral Shuffle
short_description: In an athletic stance, shuffle sideways quickly without crossing the feet.

name: Single-Under
short_description: Jump with both feet just high enough for the rope to pass under once per jump, turning the rope from the wrists.

name: Double-Under
short_description: Jump slightly higher and spin the rope fast so it passes under the feet twice per jump.

name: Triple-Under
short_description: Jump high with a tight hollow body and spin the rope three times under the feet per jump.

name: Single-Leg Jump Rope Hop
short_description: Jump rope hopping on one foot only, then switch feet after a set count or time.

name: Single-Leg Double-Under
short_description: Perform double-unders while hopping on one foot only.

name: Jump Rope Boxer Step
short_description: Shift weight from one foot to the other every couple of rope turns with a light double tap, like a relaxed boxer.

name: Jump Rope Alternate-Foot Step
short_description: Jog in place over the rope, alternating feet so one foot clears each turn.

name: High-Knee Jump Rope
short_description: Run in place over the rope, driving each knee up to hip height.

name: Jump Rope Side Straddle
short_description: Alternate landing with feet wide and feet together like a jumping jack while turning the rope.

name: Jump Rope Scissors
short_description: Land each jump in a short split stance, switching which foot is forward every jump.

name: Jump Rope Skier
short_description: Hop with feet together a few inches side to side on each turn of the rope.

name: Jump Rope Bell
short_description: Hop with feet together a few inches forward and back on each turn of the rope.

name: Jump Rope Heel-Toe
short_description: While hopping on one foot, tap the other heel forward, then its toe beside you, then switch.

name: Jump Rope Criss-Cross
short_description: On one jump cross the arms in front so the hands pass the hips, jump through the loop, then uncross on the next.

name: Jump Rope Side Swing
short_description: Bring both handles together and swing the rope beside the body, then open it to resume jumping.

name: Double-Under Crossover
short_description: Perform a double-under in which the arms cross on the second rope pass and uncross on the next jump.

name: Backward Single-Under
short_description: Turn the rope from front to back over the head and jump it as it passes under the heels.

name: Double-Under Boxer Step
short_description: Perform double-unders while alternating weight foot to foot each jump.

name: Penguin Jumps (no rope)
short_description: Jump as high as for a double-under and tap the thighs twice with the hands before landing; a no-rope DU substitute.

name: Squat Jump
short_description: Squat to about parallel and explode straight up, landing softly back into the next squat.

name: Dumbbell Squat Jump
short_description: Holding light dumbbells at the sides, quarter- to half-squat and jump vertically, landing softly.

name: Tuck Jump
short_description: Jump straight up and pull both knees toward the chest at the top before landing softly.

name: Jump and Reach
short_description: Dip quickly and jump as high as possible, reaching both arms toward the ceiling, then land and reset.

name: Broad Jump
short_description: Swing the arms and jump forward as far as possible from two feet, sticking a balanced two-foot landing.

name: Single-Leg Broad Jump
short_description: Jump forward off one leg and land on the same leg, sticking the landing for a beat.

name: Burpee Broad Jump
short_description: Perform a burpee and, instead of jumping vertically, broad jump forward to start the next rep.

name: Lateral Burpee Over Line
short_description: Perform a burpee parallel to a line or low object and jump laterally over it with both feet.

name: Lateral Step-Over
short_description: Step laterally over a line or low object one foot at a time; the no-impact version of hop-overs.

name: Lateral Line Hop
short_description: Hop side to side over a line with both feet using quick, springy contacts; a common Street Parking jump rope substitute.

name: Lateral Jump Over Dumbbell
short_description: Jump laterally with both feet over a low object such as a dumbbell on its side, landing softly each time.

name: Forward-Backward Line Hop
short_description: Hop forward and back over a line with feet together using quick, light contacts.

name: Skater Jump
short_description: Leap sideways from one leg to the other, landing softly and swinging the trailing leg behind.

name: Lateral Bound
short_description: Bound laterally for maximum distance from one leg and stick the landing on the opposite leg for a beat.

name: Split Squat Jump
short_description: From a lunge, jump explosively and switch legs in the air to land in a lunge on the opposite side.

name: Pogo Hops
short_description: Bounce in place on the balls of the feet with stiff ankles and minimal knee bend, minimizing ground contact time.

name: Single-Leg Pogo Hops
short_description: Perform quick, stiff-ankle pogo hops on one foot.

name: Single-Leg Hop to Stick
short_description: Hop forward on one leg and freeze the landing for 2-3 seconds with the knee tracking over the toes.

name: Hexagon Drill
short_description: Facing one direction, hop out and back into the center of a taped hexagon, moving around each side in turn.

name: Lateral Over-Unders
short_description: Alternate hopping laterally over a low object and ducking under a higher one in a continuous side-to-side pattern.

name: Frog Jump
short_description: From a deep wide squat with hands touching the floor, jump forward and land back in the deep squat.

name: 180-Degree Jump
short_description: Jump vertically and rotate 180 degrees in the air, landing softly facing the opposite direction.

name: Bounding
short_description: Run with exaggerated, powerful strides, pushing off each leg for maximum horizontal distance and air time.

name: Power Skip
short_description: Skip forward driving the knee and opposite arm high to maximize height on each skip.

name: Skip in Place
short_description: Skip rhythmically in place, lifting alternate knees with a small hop on the support leg.

name: High Knees
short_description: Run in place, driving each knee up to hip height with quick ground contacts.

name: Marching High Knees
short_description: March in place driving each knee to hip height with an opposite-arm swing; the no-impact high-knee option.

name: Jumping Jack
short_description: Jump the feet wide while raising the arms overhead, then jump back together with arms at the sides.

name: Step Jack
short_description: Step one foot out to the side while raising the arms overhead, then return; alternate sides.

name: Seal Jack
short_description: Perform a jumping jack while clapping the arms together in front at shoulder height instead of overhead.

name: Star Jump
short_description: From a quarter squat, explode upward spreading arms and legs into a star shape, then land with feet together.

name: Squat Jack
short_description: Jump the feet out into a wide squat and back together while staying low in the squat.

name: Plank Jack
short_description: In a high plank, jump the feet out wide and back together while keeping the hips level.

name: Plyometric Push-Up
short_description: Lower into a push-up and press explosively so the hands leave the floor, landing softly into the next rep.

name: Clap Push-Up
short_description: Press explosively out of a push-up and clap the hands before catching yourself in the next rep.

name: Hurdle Hop
short_description: Hop with both feet over a series of low hurdles or cones with quick, springy contacts.

name: Box Jump
short_description: Jump from two feet onto a box, landing softly and standing to full hip extension on top. BOX REQUIRED.

name: Box Jump-Over
short_description: Jump onto or over a box and land on the other side; extension on top is not required. BOX REQUIRED.

name: Burpee Box Jump-Over
short_description: Perform a burpee facing a box, then jump onto or over it to the other side. BOX REQUIRED.

name: Depth Drop
short_description: Step off a low box and absorb the landing into an athletic quarter squat, freezing on contact. BOX REQUIRED.

name: Depth Jump
short_description: Step off a low box and, on landing, immediately rebound into a maximal vertical jump with minimal ground contact. BOX REQUIRED.

name: Seated Box Jump
short_description: From sitting on a bench, jump straight onto a box in front of you without a countermovement. BOX REQUIRED.

name: Weighted Vest Walk
short_description: Wear a snug weighted vest (start around 5-10% of bodyweight) and walk briskly with upright posture for time or distance.

name: Ruck March
short_description: Walk at a fast, sustained pace over longer distances under a loaded vest or rucksack.

name: Weighted Vest Hill/Incline Walk
short_description: Walk uphill (outdoor hill or inclined treadmill) wearing a weighted vest, keeping an upright torso.

name: Weighted Vest Hike
short_description: Hike varied terrain wearing a weighted vest at a steady, conversational effort.

name: Weighted Vest Run
short_description: Run short-to-moderate distances wearing a light, snug vest; keep loads light to protect joints.

name: Weighted Vest Shuttle Run
short_description: Perform shuttle runs between two lines wearing a weighted vest, decelerating under control at each turn.

name: Weighted Vest Stair Climb
short_description: Climb flights of stairs at a steady pace wearing a weighted vest, walking down for recovery.

name: Weighted Vest Step-Up
short_description: Wearing a weighted vest, step onto a sturdy step, bench, or box and stand fully before stepping down.

name: Weighted Vest March in Place
short_description: March in place with high knees and an opposite arm swing while wearing a weighted vest; a quiet indoor vest option.

name: Weighted Vest Plank
short_description: Hold a front plank wearing a weighted vest, keeping the hips from sagging under the extra load.

name: Weighted Vest Bear Crawl
short_description: Bear crawl forward and back wearing a weighted vest, keeping the knees an inch off the ground and the back flat.
